zh.title: 稳定性与体验
items: • 优化剪贴板监听和图片条目加载，减少重复收录与无效读取。
• 改进浮窗动画、窗口置顶、搜索输入及历史删除体验。
• 完善数据迁移、安装语言选择、图片预览和预置指令管理。

en.title: Stability and experience
items: • Improved clipboard capture and image-item loading to reduce duplicate entries and unnecessary reads.
• Refined floating-window animation, always-on-top behavior, search input, and history deletion.
• Improved data migration, installer language selection, image preview, and built-in instruction management.

zh.title: 当前版本
items: • 新增更新日志，方便查看软件迭代。
• 强化 Agent 的系统提示、网页检索和上下文节约规则。

en.title: Current version
items: • Added release notes with bilingual version content for easier tracking of product changes.
• Strengthened Agent instructions, public web search safeguards, and context-saving rules.

zh.title: 数据迁移与安全
items: • 支持导出、导入和迁移设置、工作区、历史与书签数据。
• 导入前增加完整性校验与回滚保护，降低数据迁移风险。

en.title: Data migration and security
items: • Added export, import, and migration for settings, workspaces, history, and bookmarks.
• Added import validation and rollback protection to reduce migration risk.

zh.title: 体验与个性化
items: • 完善图片条目、文字背景、主题与显示语言等个性化选项。
• 新增欢迎页、用户协议和 AI 用量信息，补全首次使用与设置体验。

en.title: Experience and personalization
items: • Improved image items, text backgrounds, themes, and display-language options.
• Added the welcome tour, user agreement, and AI usage information for a more complete setup experience.

zh.title: 历史记录增强
items: • 增加独立的长期历史记录与日期筛选，工作区内容可按需保留。
• 改进图片缓存和普通历史的管理边界，提升大量条目下的稳定性。

en.title: History improvements
items: • Added independent long-term history and date filtering, with retention managed per workspace.
• Improved the boundaries between image caching and ordinary history for better stability with many items.

zh.title: Agent 稳定性
items: • 优化流式工具调用、执行过程显示和长对话上下文压缩。
• 限制工具读取范围与内容大小，减少重复调用和无关上下文。

en.title: Agent reliability
items: • Improved streamed tool calls, execution traces, and context compression for long conversations.
• Limited tool-read scope and content size to reduce repeated calls and irrelevant context.

zh.title: Agent 权限与操作
items: • 增加只读、审核批准和完全访问三档 Agent 权限。
• 支持通过 Agent 筛选、编辑、新建、删除、置顶和标记文字条目。

en.title: Agent permissions and actions
items: • Added read-only, approval-required, and full-access Agent permission levels.
• Enabled Agents to filter, edit, create, delete, pin, and tag text entries.

zh.title: Agent 模式
items: • 推出基于工具调用的 AI 对话助手，可围绕当前工作区完成多条目任务。
• 支持从主窗口或单条目入口发起对话，并保留常规 AI 文本处理能力。

en.title: Agent mode
items: • Introduced a tool-using AI chat assistant for multi-item tasks in the current workspace.
• Added chat entry points from the main window and individual items while retaining standard AI text actions.

zh.title: 效率与显示
items: • 完善全局快捷键、快速粘贴、深色模式和界面显示选项。
• 支持文字编辑、格式清理、颜色标记和条目导出。

en.title: Efficiency and display
items: • Improved global shortcuts, quick paste, dark mode, and display options.
• Added text editing, format cleanup, color tags, and item export.

zh.title: 组织与检索
items: • 增加工作区、书签、置顶和关键词搜索，便于整理常用内容。
• 支持文字与图片剪贴板条目，并可按设置管理重复内容。

en.title: Organization and search
items: • Added workspaces, bookmarks, pins, and keyword search for organizing reusable content.
• Added text and image clipboard items, with configurable duplicate handling.

zh.title: 常规功能基础
items: • 建立 Windows 剪贴板监听、条目列表、快速粘贴和基础设置。
• 提供清空、新建空白条目和常用窗口操作等日常效率功能。

en.title: Core clipboard foundation
items: • Established Windows clipboard capture, an item list, quick paste, and essential settings.
• Added everyday actions such as clear, new blank item, and common window controls.
